description: Approved native PostgreSQL DML only. change.propose target.locator=database, operation=INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, one SET /statement value={statement:{sql,parameters?},read_back:{sql,parameters?,limit?},checks:[{pointer,equals}]}. BEFORE proposing, call database.query on the same resource with exactly the read_back SELECT, parameters and limit (default 1000). Use that complete, non-truncated response file content_hash as precondition.revision and include its evidence_refs. For INSERT query the new key before insertion and use the observed empty result's hash; never use a schema query, UUID/time query, another query's hash or the string absent. checks use JSON Pointers into the complete query result, for example /rows/0/status, not into file metadata; verification is READ_BACK with paths=[/statement] and may be omitted. Read-back is executed both before and after the DML; omit volatile clock/random values and order multi-row results deterministically. Transaction includes SQL, read-back and original Effect receipt. No DDL, transaction commands, multiple statements or automatic unknown-result replay. Table/column permissions are enforced by the configured database account.
title: database.execute/v1 request
